title: Multiscale polygon and continuous-surface rendering
runbook_section: LIVE / Spatial aggregation and polygon contract

external_dependencies.for: m0 consumes the frozen support-geometry and temporal envelope contract.
m1 waits for the shared reader/capability implementation to land before editing shared response files.

note: Replace coarse raw dots and disconnected blocks with semantically honest support geometry: continuous tessellations/isobands, event aggregate cells or heatmaps, and topology-preserving native polygons.

shared_writes: The reader track freezes supportKind, zoomTier and cell extent/resolution before m1 edits shared response types.
Climate and soil renderers are one lane; event renderers are another; native polygon validation owns no shared renderer file.
No simultaneous edit of parquet-climate-field.ts with the reader track.
tripwires: Fire detection-density cells must never be labeled as physical fire perimeters.
No interpolation or polygon is invented for a source that does not support it.
Exactly one physical rung renders for a zoom; raw and aggregate forms never overlap.
Adjacent cells use bit-identical boundaries and aggregate counts conserve the detail rung.
Renderer rollback cannot change reader ownership or substitute another day.

slices.task: Freeze the product-to-render-class registry and permitted zoom forms: continuous_field, event_point, native_polygon or explicit unavailable/reference.
Return exact support kind, stable cell identity, rung, origin/center semantics and cell width/height or native geometry in serving envelopes.
Render continuous climate and soil products as complete tessellating polygons, filled dissolved isobands or governed raster surfaces with no batch/tile seams.
Render coarse event/sensor aggregates as declared cell polygons, heatmaps or clusters while retaining raw points at detail zoom; implement fire density cells first.
Validate native polygon generalization/dissolve without changing source meaning; keep MTBS as the production continuity reference.
Run conservation, topology, feature-budget and screenshot/canvas-pixel checks across default PNW coarse/middle/detail zooms; publish the renderer handoff packet.

orchestration_wave1_20260902.rule: shared working tree, disjoint write sets per slice, no builds/tests inside slices, one orchestrator sweep at the join
pre_declared_seams: ParquetViewportRead.signal?: AbortSignal added by r2b, passed by r1 from wildfire.ts
